hub.title: Who's That Pokémon Quiz and More Pokémon Quiz Modes
hub.description: Play the Who's That Pokémon quiz, a cry quiz, Pokédex entries, type matchups, higher or lower — in Classic, Survival and Blitz formats.
hub.duelLine: Answer the same questions as a friend, live.
hub.infoDescription: Free Pokémon quizzes including the Who's That Pokémon quiz, a cry quiz and type matchups, in Classic, Survival and Blitz formats.
hub.infoIntro: Play the Who's That Pokémon quiz and our other Pokémon quizzes in three formats, covering all 1,025 Pokémon.
hub.step1: Pick a quiz mode and the generations to include.
hub.step2: Choose a format: Classic, Survival or Blitz.
hub.step3: Answer before the clock runs out.
hub.step4: Your PokéIQ weighs each right answer by how tricky that question is.
hub.faqFormatsA: Classic is 10 questions with 15 seconds each, Survival is endless with 3 lives and Blitz gives you 60 seconds to answer as many as you can.
hub.faqGensQ: Can I choose which generations to play?
hub.faqGensA: Yes, pick a mode, then choose the generations to include.

whos-that-pokemon.title: Who's That Pokémon? Silhouette Quiz
whos-that-pokemon.description: Guess the Pokémon from its silhouette. Pick any of the nine generations, in Classic, Survival and Blitz modes.

pokemon-cry-quiz.title: Pokémon Cry Quiz — Guess the Pokémon by Its Cry
pokemon-cry-quiz.description: Can you recognize Pokémon by their cries? Listen and guess across every generation.

pokedex-entry-quiz.title: Pokédex Entry Quiz — Guess the Pokémon from Its Pokédex Entry
pokedex-entry-quiz.description: Read a censored Pokédex entry and name the Pokémon. Plus category and ability questions.

pokemon-type-quiz.title: Pokémon Type Chart Quiz — Weaknesses, Immunities & Matchups
pokemon-type-quiz.description: Test your type chart knowledge: dual-type weaknesses, 4× matchups, immunities and typings.

pokemon-higher-or-lower.title: Pokémon Higher or Lower — Base Stats Game
pokemon-higher-or-lower.description: Which Pokémon is faster, heavier or has the higher base stat total? Keep your streak alive.

pokemon-games-quiz.title: Pokémon Games Quiz — Gym Leaders, Champions & Regions
pokemon-games-quiz.description: How well do you know the core Pokémon RPGs? Gym Leaders, Elite Four, rivals, villains, starters and regions from Red and Blue to Legends: Z-A.

pokemon-ability-move-item-quiz.title: Pokémon Ability, Move & Item Quiz
pokemon-ability-move-item-quiz.description: Which Pokémon can have this ability? What type is this move? What does this item do? Questions generated from the Pokémon Showdown data.

real-shiny-quiz.title: Which Is the Real Shiny? Pokémon Shiny Quiz
real-shiny-quiz.description: One of four colourings is the real shiny, the rest are fakes. Can you tell? Every Pokémon, on Easy or Hard.

pokemon-zoom-quiz.title: Pokémon Zoom Quiz — Zoom Reveal
pokemon-zoom-quiz.description: Name the Pokémon from an extreme close-up of its official artwork. Each miss zooms out one step, six in all, plus a daily one.

pokemon-anime-quiz.title: Pokémon Anime Quiz — Ash, Team Rocket & Horizons
pokemon-anime-quiz.description: Ash's Pokémon, his friends and rivals, Team Rocket, league results, the movies and Pokémon Horizons. Every answer checked against Bulbapedia.

whose-team-is-this.title: Whose Team Is This? — Guess the Pokémon Trainer from Their Team
whose-team-is-this.description: Gym Leaders, Elite Four, Champions, rivals and villains from every core game, plus Ash and friends from the anime: name the trainer from their team.

pokemon-trivia-quiz.title: Pokémon Trivia Quiz — Mixed Questions
pokemon-trivia-quiz.description: A mixed Pokémon quiz: silhouettes, Pokédex entries, type matchups and stat battles.

gen.title: Gen {n} Pokémon Quiz — {region} Who's That Pokémon?
gen.description: How well do you know the {region} Pokédex? Name every Gen {n} Pokémon from its silhouette.

daily.title: Daily Pokémon Challenge
daily.description: A new 10-question Pokémon quiz every day — the same for everyone. Keep your streak and compare your PokéIQ.

duel.title: A Pokémon quiz duel
duel.description: Head-to-head Pokémon quiz: the same questions for both of you, right and fast scores most.
